atoms.name: Majority vote
atoms.one_line: Predict the most common label among the $k$ nearest; odd $k$ avoids two-class ties.

atoms.name: Effect of k
atoms.one_line: Small $k$: low bias, high variance. Large $k$: smooth, high bias. $k=n$: majority class.

atoms.name: Scaling and dimension
atoms.one_line: Features need scaling; high dimensions make distances uninformative.

atoms.name: k-NN regression
atoms.one_line: Average the targets of the $k$ nearest neighbours.

atoms.name: Training and LOO error
atoms.one_line: 1-NN training error is $0$; use leave-one-out to estimate error.

atoms.name: Nearest centroid
atoms.one_line: $f=\|x-\mu_1\|^2-\|x-\mu_2\|^2$ is linear in $x$; boundary is the perpendicular bisector.
